violations.description: The publishing workflow does not have a test gate before release/publish.
violations.evidence: The `publish-pypi` job (line 35) and `create-release` job (line 22) only depend on the `build` job (line 6), but they do not depend on any test jobs (which exist in .github/workflows/tests.yaml). Therefore, a release can be published without tests running or passing.
violations.recommendation: Add `needs: [build, tests]` to the release and publish jobs to ensure tests pass before deployment.
